name: AirTrunk SYD2 Sydney North (initial phases)

address.value: 1 Sirius Road, Lane Cove West NSW 2066

lat.note: Geocoded from street address via NSW Spatial Services address point for 1 SIRIUS ROAD LANE COVE WEST; the service returns two address points for this address (-33.80614,151.14840 and -33.80779,151.14472); first used. Address point, not building centroid; campus spans a larger lot.

builder.note: FTI Group project page: 'designed by Greenbox Architecture and Van Der Meer Consulting Engineers and is being built by AW Edwards'; Beyond Fire case study (source 12) 'Builder - AW Edwards'. AW Edwards also prepared the 2025 CEMP for the Mod 3 works (see airtrunk-syd2-expansion). EMKC is the applicant's planning agent entity, not the builder

developer.note: SSD applicant listed as 'Airtrunk Pty Ltd C/- EMKC'; Mod 2/3 lodged by Greenbox Architecture on behalf of AirTrunk; post-approval correspondence addressed to The Trustee for Airtrunk Lane Cove Trust

mw_it.note: derived: campus >120 MW (AirTrunk June 2023 release, source 13) minus 70 MW final-two-phase expansion (separate row airtrunk-syd2-expansion); phases 1 and 2 opened early 2021 and early 2023. Not stated per phase by any source. Consent (as modified) caters for 138 MW across the site (source 14); Beyond Fire gives 'designed Electrical Capacity of 130 Megawatt' (source 12)

mw_grid.note: whole-site consent capacity 138 MW ('3 x 45 MVA transformers with availability to cater for 138 MW across the Site', Mod 3 report, source 14) covers all four phases, not this row alone

cost_aud_m.note: capital investment value $196,852,378 in DPIE Assessment Report (Nov 2019) for the whole SSD-9741 building (all phases, cold shell). EIS gave CIV '$216,465,700.00 (including GST)' (the CRE '$216m' figure); Mod 3 report restates $216,465,700 (exc. GST). Operator/press 'over $1bn' for the 110 MW+ campus (source 2)

authority.value: NSW Department of Planning, Industry and Environment (now DPHI)
authority.note: determined by Executive Director under delegation

reference.note: modified by Mod 1 (fuel storage/generators, determined 14 Apr 2020), Mod 2 (2 Apollo Place office, GFA to 39,319 m2, operational jobs 100 to 130; lodged 21 Sep 2020, determined 16 Dec 2020; EXH-9395018 was the Mod 2 exhibition) and Mod 3 (design changes, determined 13 Jun 2024 - see airtrunk-syd2-expansion). Portal project id 9381, slug lane-cove-west-data-centre

lodged.note: application form filed on portal 28 Mar 2019 ('Application_20190328'); EIS uploaded 9 Apr 2019 and exhibited 11 Apr - 13 May 2019; amended application (clause 55) with updated EIS Sept 2019. Exact lodgement date not stated in AR

jobs_construction.note: AR (TIA): 'there would be maximum of 320 workers on-site at any given time'; elsewhere 'approximately 320 construction jobs'. Whole SSD-9741 (all phases)

jobs_operational.note: Mod 2 AR: 'an increase in the number of operational jobs generated by the development, from 100 jobs to 130 jobs'. Whole campus

jobs_operational_other.note: original AR: 'up to 100 full-time equivalent operational jobs'. EIS (source 16) gave a range: 'Approximately, 80-100 full-time operational jobs' incl. customer staff; Mod 3 report (source 14) restates 'Approximately 80 - 100 ongoing jobs'

construction_start.note: not stated. Site settled Nov 2019 (source 8); Mod 1 AR (Apr 2020) states 'the Applicant has commenced bulk earthworks across the site', so works began between Nov 2019 and Apr 2020

construction_end.note: phase 1: operations notified to commence 2 Mar 2021 (notice of commencement, source 18); phase 2 opened early 2023 'delivered in under 35 weeks' (AirTrunk June 2023 release)

open_questions: row split: mw_it 50 is derived (campus >120 MW minus 70 MW expansion); per-phase MW not stated; CIV, jobs and 138 MW capacity are whole-SSD figures shared with airtrunk-syd2-expansion
exact SSD lodgement date not stated (application filed 28 Mar 2019)
